known_gaps.description: Physical reboot and logon-trigger startup were not executed.
known_gaps.remediation: After reboot run codex_mcp_service_tasks.ps1 -Status -Json and require both services healthy and managed.

known_gaps.description: Endpoint-matched PostToolUse proof ledger remains absent despite successful active-session tool calls.
known_gaps.remediation: Start a fresh Codex task from the managed shortcut, rerun the four live tools, and rerun both diagnosis commands.

known_gaps.description: Codex primary governance verification is blocked by a pre-existing root .agents directory outside this change.
known_gaps.remediation: Disposition the duplicate enforcement home under the repo governance contract, then rerun verify_codex_enforcement_home.py and verify_codex_primary.py.

rca.symptom: Required ADG and Memory URL MCP services were intermittently absent before Codex thread initialization.
rca.root_cause: No repo-owned pre-Codex Windows lifecycle owner existed; SessionStart was too late and the old preflight only synchronized configuration.
rca.evidence: Baseline had drifted user-profile task actions, no listeners, failed active MCP calls, and a config-only preflight that passed.
rca.fix_or_next: next: Use the Codex Agentic Workflow shortcut; it repairs Scheduled Tasks, ensures protocol health, and launches Codex only after both health tools pass.
rca.recurrence_guard: Current-user logon plus one-minute watchdog triggers, IgnoreNew, exact ownership receipts, fail-closed foreign-port checks, protocol probes, and status-only SessionStart verification.

closeout_20260711.governance_debt: Pre-existing root .agents directory blocks Codex enforcement-home verification and was not modified.
